question: What are the main stages of the example multimodal QA pipeline?

ground_truth_evidences.content: The pipeline parses a document, builds text chunks, extracts figure assets, and retrieves both text and image candidates before generating an answer.

reference_answer: The pipeline first parses the document, then builds text chunks and figure assets, retrieves text and image candidates, and finally generates an answer with optional image display.

question: Why does the system use an image display gate?

ground_truth_evidences.content: The image gate decides whether a question needs visual evidence and prevents unrelated figures from being shown in text-only answers.

reference_answer: The image display gate checks whether visual evidence is useful for the current question, so the system can show relevant figures only when they help the answer.
